purpose: Prove that a characteristic remains attached to the intended semantic geometry, not merely that an annotation exists after reopen.

levels.test: save-close-reopen candidate; semantic annotation/persistent reference resolves
SOLIDWORKS ForceRebuild3(false) on a disposable/read-only verification candidate; resolve characteristic semantic geometry before/after and compare semantic signature
levels.proves: binding survives topology regeneration without parameter change

levels.test: on a disposable candidate only, apply an approved benign parameter perturbation, rebuild, restore original value, rebuild again; characteristic must resolve to the same functional semantic role/signature at every state
levels.proves: binding selector is not accidentally tied to unstable runtime face numbering/topology order

fail_closed_rules: Runtime face index alone is never binding authority.
Zero or multiple semantic matches => HOLD; never choose first match.
A save/reopen PMI PASS cannot substitute for L2/L3 geometry-binding qualification.
Canonical CAD is never modified for L3; use a timestamped disposable candidate and verify canonical SHA invariance.
current_evidence_note: C02/C05 have proven PMI save-close-reopen persistence, but P007 characteristic-to-geometry rebuild/perturbation invariance is not yet a release PASS. C07/C08 remain CANONICAL_REBIND_REQUIRED.
